goal: Identify a coherent, calibrated, non-overlapping avoidable cost budget of at least 0.10 s/ordinary step before selecting a prototype.
scope: Static contracts for interpreting the frozen source call-site map and runtime tape; these are hypotheses to audit, not instructions to remove work.

contracts.lifetime: Existing generation predicates compare each cached plan to block_writeback_plan_generation.
contracts.falsification: Predominantly reused requests with small total construction time rule out frequent unnecessary plan construction as a large target.
contracts.proof_needed: A rebuild may follow real topology, ownership, allocation or layout changes. Equal block counts do not prove equal topology.

contracts.object: cached geometry and scalar physical residuals
contracts.lifetime: Full transport seeds geometry after invalidation; compact captures still need live physical residuals. Existing cumulative producer counters are sampled only at batch boundaries.
contracts.falsification: Geometry seeded once per necessary generation, with later stages carrying live residuals, refutes repeated unchanged full-record transport.
contracts.proof_needed: Before deleting a repeated seed, establish unchanged geometry inputs AND retained destination storage. Same plan generation does not prove unchanged live physical fields.

contracts.lifetime: Record payload family, stage and generation in order. Publication can serve multiple actual consumers; import can be preceded by a required Domain producer.
contracts.falsification: Every materialization precedes a required consumer after a genuine value change, or aggregate eligible cost is too small.
contracts.proof_needed: Audit all writes and consumers of the specific field family before declaring a repeated transition redundant. This campaign deliberately does not add point-level value comparisons or assume stage identity is a value-version proof.

contracts.lifetime: Four manifest, six size and three payload reductions plus payload checksum scans execute in the existing migration protocol. Full validation selector does not disable these.
contracts.falsification: Validation scans/reductions are too small, or moving/batching them cannot preserve global rejection and installation ordering.
contracts.proof_needed: Separate integrity checks from payload exchanges and convergence/dependency reductions; preserve error detection and safe collective ordering. Never remove checks based only on their names.

rules: Retain negative differences and unselected remainder. Never add nested inclusive timers.
Selected MPI wait includes progress and producer imbalance; no automatic communication savings estimate.
Per-site send/receive totals are datatype elements, not DRAM bytes or values necessarily used by every consumer.
Profiler calibration is required but does not itself prove removability or critical-path speedup.
If no candidate supports the target, reject this hypothesis rather than accumulate unrelated one-percent changes.
